name: cuban-press-dumbbell
title: Cuban Press: Dumbbell
primer: This is a three point exercise for shoulder and middle back strengthening.
steps: Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip (palms facing backwards, your shoulders rotated forward).
Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and your knees slightly bent, and contract your abdominals.
Slowly lift your arms up so your elbows are bent and your upper arms are parallel with the floor while you squeeze your shoulders together.
Rotate your arms, bringing the dumbbells forward so that they are now above your shoulders and in line with your elbows.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower them back to shoulder height.
In a controlled manner lower your arms and return to the starting position.
tips: Start with a lower weight in order to perfect the technique.
Maintain a good upright posture throughout the exercise.
